text: First group, they were told as they punched a bag to think of the person who critiqued them. The second group was told to punch a bag, but they were not given the prompt to think of the person who critiqued them. And the third group, they were not given any prompts or any punching bags. Of the three groups, which of these three groups do you think reported escalated anger? You already know the answer. It was the group that was thinking about.
